name: Cheating On A Test
overview: Scripture clearly condemns dishonesty and theft, emphasizing that believers must not steal or lie to one another, as seen in Leviticus 19:11 and Deuteronomy 5:19. Integrity is vital; Proverbs teaches that those who live uprightly walk securely, while those who distort their ways will be exposed (Proverbs 10:9). Lying is detestable to the Lord, but truthfulness brings His delight (Proverbs 12:22). Cheating on a test falls under these prohibitions, reflecting a failure to honor God through honest conduct.
